amendment_policy.semver_rules: MAJOR: remove/redefine frozen case meaning or floor policy. MINOR: add cases or non-breaking fields after principal accept. PATCH: typos, notes, generator params that do not change intention/result. Never silently edit a frozen case_id in place — archive + replace under amendment log.

Q1.2 Commerce + Messaging: seeded generators + Tier-A intention cases (draft). Dogfood: invented_honest_label (no in-tree dogfood). Floors still unenforced.
